concern: Subjunctive دیں (den) is doubled to "dein" (twice: dhansa dein, gira dein) though R2 requires it stay single-vowel; the parallel verb "chaahen" (چاہیں) in the same clause is correctly single-vowel, and the same construction is rendered "den" correctly elsewhere in this batch (41:16, 41:29, 42:7, 42:15).
suggestion: Agar hum chaahen to unhein zameen mein dhansa den ya un par aasman ke tukde gira den

concern: کردیں (subjunctive den) rendered "kar dein" (double vowel); R2 requires single-vowel "den".
suggestion: hum un logon ko jo aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain zaahir kar den

concern: ان appears three times in this sentence for the same referent (the false partners); first and third are correctly "un", but the middle one switches to "in" (near) for no apparent reason: "na un ka in mein koi hissa hai".
suggestion: na un ka un mein koi hissa hai

concern: Shafaa'at carries an apostrophe, violating R5's explicit ruling that this exact word is written without one ("shafaat" is R5's own listed example).
suggestion: Shafaat (sifaarish) bhi us ke paas kuch nafa nahi deti

concern: کردیں (subjunctive den) rendered "kar dein" (double vowel); R2 requires single-vowel "den".
suggestion: tumhein hamare paas (martabon se) qareeb kar den
